title: zoysia pacifica
intro: Zoysia pacifica, commonly known as Pacific Zoysia, is a type of warm-season grass native to the Pacific Islands. It is known for its dense and soft texture, making it a popular choice for lawns and landscaping. The health benefits of Zoysia pacifica include reducing stress and anxiety, improving sleep quality, and promoting a sense of calm, while its therapeutic actions include soothing inflammation and relaxing muscle tension. The bioactive constituents of Zoysia pacifica include flavonoids, saponins, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
